definition: pSeven SAS is a software development company, evolved out of several simulation and optimization projects performed for Airbus divisions in the early 2000’s.
details: pSeven SAS operates on the market of PIDO software and collaborative engineering environments. Company is founded in 2010 as a joint venture with Airbus. In 2016 pSeven SAS team redeemed Airbus’s share in the company and became independent.

explainer.lead: pSeven SAS is a software company in process integration and design optimisation, grown out of simulation and optimisation work for Airbus.

tiers.eli5: It's a company that started by helping build better aeroplane designs and then spun off to sell that expertise.
tiers.practitioner: It matters to engineering teams because it supplies PIDO and collaborative engineering tools; its origin as a joint venture shaped its focus on industrial design workflows.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; the company was founded in 2010 as a joint venture with Airbus, and in 2016 its team redeemed Airbus's share and became independent.

explainer.example: Engineers working on design optimisation projects use software from pSeven SAS, a company founded in 2010 as an Airbus joint venture.
